title: Centrifuge and Pipette Preparation Tables
description: One static instrument-preparation scene from the original laboratory sample-preparation direction, not a procedure. The complete original benchtop centrifuge with its thick blind-bottom chamber, centrally supported eight blind wells, fixed open lid, original bored hinge/pin, blank controls and all four feet is placed on one whole original worktable. A separate whole original worktable supports the complete original cantilever pipette rack kit with both original full pipettes, three front-open slots and its empty third slot. The whole centrifuge is turned exactly90 degrees about vertical to fit its entire footprint within the actual table top; neither its lid nor any internal part is altered. Every original local POSITION/NORMAL/index/PBR and internal hierarchy byte remains intact. Only whole unit-scale placements and one finite floor are authored. Both entire tabletop child footprints are proved on the actual finite convex top surfaces, with original soles at their heights; the two complete table stations have a positive physical gap and do not pretend to be one continuous fitted bench. This is distinct from the existing microscope and three-vial observation corner. One scene, zero new independent models; repeated support tables are not new models or a new table family. No vessel-capacity, colour, instrument-count variants, operating display, rotor motion, lid sweep, liquid, biological material, reagent, experiment steps, actual scientific performance, sterile handling, chemical/biological/ventilation or equipment/load safety.
